source: ETS TOEFL ITP Level 1 Practice Tests Volume 1, Practice Test A

listening.overview: This section measures your ability to understand spoken English. The audio is played in sequence and the conversations and talks are not repeated.
listening.partA: You will hear short conversations. After each conversation, you will hear a question. Read the four answers and choose the best answer.
listening.partB: You will hear longer conversations. After each conversation, you will hear several questions. The conversations and questions will not be repeated.
listening.partC: You will hear several short talks. After each talk, you will hear some questions. The talks and questions will not be repeated.

structure.overview: This section is designed to measure your ability to recognize language that is appropriate for standard written English. There are two types of questions in this section, with special directions for each type.
structure.time: 25 minutes, including the reading of directions.
structure.partA: Questions 1–15 are incomplete sentences. Beneath each sentence you will see four words or phrases, marked (A), (B), (C) and (D). Choose the word or phrase that best completes the sentence.
structure.partB: In questions 16–40, each sentence has four underlined words or phrases. The underlined parts of the sentence are marked (A), (B), (C) and (D). Identify the underlined word or phrase that must be changed in order for the sentence to be correct.

reading.overview: In this section you will read several passages. Each passage is followed by several questions about it. For questions 1–50, choose the best answer, (A), (B), (C) or (D), to each question.
reading.time: 55 minutes, including the reading of the directions.
reading.basis: Answer all questions following a passage on the basis of what is stated or implied in that passage.
